categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Leili Motor Co., Ltd primarily operates in four main business segments: household appliance motors and components, automotive motors and parts (especially for new energy vehicles), medical and sports health motors and components, and industrial control motors and components. The company focuses on R&D, production, and sales of micro motors and intelligent components used in these sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including micro motor design, integrated motor-control systems, and precision manufacturing techniques such as laser radar motors for vehicles, brushless DC motors, and precision stamping and die-casting. It has highly automated production lines with over 77 automated lines and emphasizes intelligent manufacturing and modular product design. R&D efforts focus on mechatronics integration, motor soft control, and high-efficiency motor technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international household appliance manufacturers (e.g., Gree, Midea, Electrolux, Whirlpool, LG, Panasonic), new energy vehicle parts suppliers (e.g., BYD, Huawei), medical device manufacturers (e.g., Mindray, Siemens Healthineers), and industrial equipment producers. The company serves markets in household appliances, new energy vehicles, medical instruments, and industrial automation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province, and has established manufacturing and R&D bases overseas including Vietnam, Mexico, the United States, South Korea, and Hong Kong. Overseas sales account for approximately 46.65% of revenue, with significant export markets in North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Leili operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of micro motors, motor components, and integrated motor-control modules to downstream OEMs in household appliances, automotive, medical, and industrial sectors. It also engages in upstream activities through investments in key suppliers and precision component manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on becoming an expert in motor drive system solutions, emphasizing mechatronics integration of motor, control, and software. R&D priorities include new energy vehicle motors (laser radar motors, electronic water pumps, electric air conditioning compressors), medical device motors (voice coil and hollow cup motors), industrial control motors, and intelligent robotic components such as dexterous hands. It invests heavily in automation, intelligent manufacturing, and international capacity expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of micro motors, motor components, and integrated modules to OEM customers in household appliances, automotive, medical, and industrial sectors. The company uses a direct sales model supplemented by some distributor sales channels, with long-term framework agreements and order-based deliveries. It also earns government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Leili is a leading domestic and global player in the micro motor and intelligent component manufacturing industry, recognized as the largest modular micro motor solutions provider in China. It competes with other specialized motor manufacturers in household appliances, automotive parts, and industrial motors, leveraging its strong R&D, automation, and international presence to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.52 billion, a 14.38% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 294 million, slightly down 7.14%. It has steadily grown its automotive and industrial control segments, with automotive revenue up 30.42% and industrial control up 24%. The company maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 6.44 billion and continues to invest in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Leili emphasizes its role as a motor drive system solution expert, offering high-quality, cost-effective, and technologically advanced micro motors and integrated modules. Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities with over 1,400 patents, advanced automation and intelligent manufacturing, close collaboration with leading OEMs for synchronized product development, and a diversified product portfolio across multiple high-growth sectors such as new energy vehicles and medical devices.
